messages:
Lia: Hey infra — seeing recurring latency spikes on fractional-slices in us-west2 around 11:00. Looks like multiple tenants being coalesced onto the same GPU shelf during warmup; KV-cache churn and egress jitter. Anyone else seeing this?
Kevin: Yup saw it ~11:02. Tail spikes + token-generation slowdowns. top of trace shows lots of small forward-only jobs landing on the same slab -> kvcache regen.
ops-bot: warm-pool-prefill: completed 2024-03-12T11:01:03Z prefill_count=24 source=allocator
sre-alex: We rolled scheduler change 'sticky-lease-batching' at 10:58 to reduce churn. Sounds like it introduced coalescence. rolling a mitigation.
Jitendra: Instead of full rollback can we add jitter & per-shelf caps? Proposal:
- add random warmup jitter 30-90s to prefill assignments
- enforce --prefill-max-per-shelf=3
- prefer alternate AZ for prefill when shelf kvcache_hot=true
- throttle tenant heartbeat fanout
Kevin: +1. Quick mitigation I can push: set lease_jitter=60 and prefill cap. Will canary to us-west2-edge only.
Lia: Can you add a short alert too? Query suggestion:
```
alert: PrefillPerShelfHigh
expr: sum(prefill_count) by (shelf) > 3
for: 5m
```
Also add a note to the runbook: 'warmup-coalesce' play.
sre-alex: Canary started (scheduler-v1.9.3-canary -> us-west2-edge). If tail latency improves within 10m we'll promote. Also temp route tweak: mark heavy io tenants with `route:avoid=hot-io` so allocator prefers quieter shelves.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: started canary deploy scheduler-v1.9.3-canary -> us-west2-edge (id: dpl-7783)
Lia: Thanks. Initial numbers look promising (tail down ~1.8%). Cost uptick negligible, but this was causing a 2% tail regression previously. Keep eyes on: kvcache_misses, egress_queue_depth, tenant_affinity_ratio.
Kevin: I'll follow up with a short postmortem draft and the patch PR link shortly. 👀
Lia: thanks team :thumbsup:
